name: scenes/aquarium_back
prompt: Create one production illustration for Licurici, therapy games for young and autistic children. Water: soft turquoise at the top gently deepening to calm medium blue, very low contrast, no dark areas. A pale sandy floor seen slightly from above: its far edge is at about y=800 (gently wavy) and it comes toward the viewer down to the bottom edge, smooth sand with a few tiny pebbles and soft light dapples. Far in the background, very faded blue-tinted hazy silhouettes of rounded rocks and branching corals. Near the LEFT and RIGHT edges only (each within the outer 18% of the width), resting on the sand: a few soft rounded rocks with mint moss, one pink branching coral, one peach fan coral, one lavender tube coral cluster, one small yellow brain coral. The central 64% of the width, from the top down to the sand, stays calm open water with nothing in it. No fish, no animals, no seaweed, no light rays, no bubbles, no particles, no water surface line, no treasure chest. No text, letters, numerals, labels, watermark, border, harsh red, frightening shapes.
